synopsis: The physical app supports a useful authored path from family details and preparations into a saved meetup, practice and the emergency card. Home edits now have direct physical persistence evidence. Large-text review confirms readable wrapping and a stable floor diagram, while revealing substantial navigation distance between a scene and its decisions. Actual native Codex/context/action/scoring evidence and controlled paired cases remain required.

fact_findings.evidence: HomePersistenceUITests body and retained physical opening screenshot
fact_findings.finding: Restored room name appears in the diagram and selected opening description; Window is selected after relaunch. Per-person escape confirmation remains separate, so reclassification itself does not imply usable egress.

Prior urgency palette conflict is improved: urgent effort badges now share urgency treatment and warnings occupy a trailing column. Domain/title text still repeats an equipment subject in separate title and detail areas, adding density.
Household name occupies multiple lines without clipping; editable name and age category remain distinguishable. Save and Cancel fit the toolbar.
Room names use a consistent compact scale and fit inspected Oak rooms including storage. Home explanation wraps without overlap and view selector is readable.

failures.observed: Screen title truncates between a wide leading navigation control and Undo/Save at ordinary text size.
failures.impact: Selected-object identity relies on the inspector below rather than a readable screen title.
failures.correction: Use a shorter stable editor title or redistribute leading navigation width while preserving obvious Save.

failures.observed: Longest opening-type segment truncates at ordinary size while selected Window remains legible.
failures.impact: An alternative classification label is harder to identify.
failures.correction: Use a compact picker or adaptive layout with full option labels at large text sizes.

failures.expected: Quickly identify the first useful action without excessive preamble.
failures.observed: Household label, fictional-mode badge and repeated hierarchy consume most of the first viewport. First priority row starts at y585.7 and is 953 points tall, exceeding the 874-point screen; next row starts at y1563.7.
failures.impact: Deep scrolling is needed to understand one complete priority; comparison is cumbersome.
failures.fix: Use one concise hierarchy and compact example disclosure; remove repeated subject and redundant decorative/status elements from priority previews; preserve full accessible detail through the direct task action. Recheck with actual AX scrolling.

failures.kind: observed native friction and evidence gap
failures.expected: Nearby household/scene context helps the family understand current choices.
failures.observed: Auto-positioned decision view shows options while the scene lies far above: fire diagram y-2850.3, tornado diagram y-1614.7. Repeated route/status explanations increase separation. New occupant-state renderer is outside the captured viewport.
failures.impact: Several screenfuls of scrolling and memory are needed to compare a route with the choice. Current captures cannot visually accept occupant statuses.
failures.fix: Keep one concise scene summary beside the decision and move secondary route explanations behind a direct detail action. Add bounded native instrumentation explicitly capturing the scene before/after committed fire/tornado choices and named occupant statuses. Preserve Dynamic Type sizing.
failures.likely_stage: native hierarchy and review instrumentation; high confidence

recommendations.action: Configure an authorized synthetic native gateway profile; retain exact input bundle and receipts; demonstrate saved fact -> serialized context/retrieval -> actual model result -> validated action -> persisted evidence. Server probes, mocks and absence of logs cannot certify native acceptance.
Test applicable check retirement, competency preservation, score-evidence refresh and useful next action in the real native journey. Practice navigation alone does not establish scoring.

Provide isolated assistance, medication-storage, floor/access, owned-versus-missing inventory, budget/transport and prior-performance pairs with preregistered expectations from report-family-experience-preregistered-plan-1. Include a retrieval-only fact and post-resume test. Reviewer does not patch implementation.
Explicit matched native before/after scene capture and committed-state comparison are needed for the new fire/tornado occupant renderer; decision tour scrolls away from it.
Cover Lake/Pine, all six hazards, causal alternatives, switches during requests, reset/relaunch, late responses, offline states and ordinary/official/simulated routes. Record provider mode for each.

retests: After fixes use the same fixture and ordinary/AX XXL text; verify initial priority visibility, complete option reachability, nearby scene context, family-name wrapping and room labels.
Repeat physical Save/relaunch after editor/persistence changes.
Physical RoomPlan acquisition needs owner movement; valid-dimension unit tests cannot replace acquisition evidence.
limitations: Bounded synthetic agent audit; no real-family research, clinical validation or emergency-expert certification.
No native live Codex/full-context/retrieval observed; unconfigured client source is only an implementation path.
Current independent native journey coverage is Oak. Existing reports provide context but do not replace independent all-family/hazard/deep-branch acceptance.
AX captures show first or auto-positioned viewports; no complete scrolling, VoiceOver interaction, long translations, light mode or orientation acceptance.
Masks conservatively include aggregate regions, so hidden-content correctness and layout findings derive from reviewer inspection of originals; derivatives alone cannot establish them.
Initial automation failure and successful single retry both retained. No locale, system text size or device settings changed; AX is an app launch override.

All selected tests/tour ended, final tour terminated the fictional app; exclusive phone reservation is released now. No owner vault was used. Separate retained encrypted synthetic namespace is evidence only.
